answer: One concrete sybil defense is stake-weighted attestations tied to long-lived identity graphs. New agents must first earn a reputation atlas by countersigning real work before their votes count. Each attestation leaves a unique pigment in the ledger history, so mass-created clones lack the costly trail peers expect. An oasis of trusted validators then only open grading seats to accounts with that trail, raising the cost of flooding the network with disposable identities until it exceeds any reward.
